title: Order pipeline
description: Every hop an online order takes — vendor → online → SQS → main → outbox → SSE → Pi ack → accept — with throughput, drops, backlogs and firing alerts, by env and store.

list.name: pg
list.label: Store database
list.description: Follows env: pg-prod / pg-staging (no Postgres datasource for dev).

list.name: store
list.label: Store
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT tenant AS __value, store_name AS __text FROM reporting.stores ORDER BY 2
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tenant AS __value, store_name AS __text FROM reporting.stores ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Online orders received
panels.description: Vendor orders the online relay accepted. Online has no store label, so this is every store's traffic even when one store is selected.

panels.title: Saved by main
panels.description: Orders main cast, routed to a store and wrote to Postgres (duplicates excluded). Lower than received = drops below: see the Drops row.

panels.title: Reached the Pi
panels.description: Orders the store's Pi acknowledged (order.ack). Should equal 'Saved by main'.

panels.title: Accepted on the floor
panels.description: Online orders staff accepted on the tablet (from the Pi's accept-time histogram).

panels.title: Reach rate
panels.description: Reached the Pi ÷ saved by main. Under 98 % means some orders did not get to a store's floor in this range: check 'Waiting for the Pi now' and the Pi & printers dashboard.

panels.title: Waiting for the Pi now
panels.description: Orders main has that a Pi has not acknowledged for over a minute (main re-sends every 10 s). Must be 0 — red means an order may not be on the floor: check that store's Pi and tablet now.

panels.title: Floor changes not synced
panels.description: Floor events (accepts, ready, drivers) the Pis still hold for main. Above 0 for 15 min fires an alert: the store's internet or main is unreachable; main's order status is stale meanwhile.

panels.title: Pis connected to main
panels.description: SSE subscribers on main (one per connected Pi). 0 = no store can receive orders: orders queue in main's outbox until a Pi reconnects.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Order-pipeline alert rules firing or pending for this env (each also pages Pushover). Empty = nothing is stuck. Open a rule for its query and the module to look at.

panels.title: Drops by hop (selected range) — each maps to a Pushover rule
Online rejected
panels.description: Vendor POSTs the online relay refused (bad body or SQS publish error). Above 0: check online's logs; the vendor will usually retry.

panels.title: Unroutable (DLQ)
panels.description: Messages main could not cast or route to a store (unknown store_id/name, bad body) — sent to the dead-letter queue, never saved. Above 0: set the tenant's store id in admin, then redrive the DLQ.

panels.title: Save failed
panels.description: Orders main cast but could not write to Postgres (left on the queue to retry). Above 0: check main's database.

panels.title: Push failed
panels.description: Outbox dispatch errors in main (the SSE push to the Pi errored). Above 0 and growing: check main's logs.

panels.title: Sent with no Pi listening
panels.description: Order frames main broadcast while no Pi was connected. Delayed, not lost (outbox retries) — but nothing prints until the Pi reconnects.

panels.title: Re-sent to the Pi
panels.description: Orders main had to re-send because the Pi had not acked them. A few after a reconnect are normal; a steady stream means the Pi link is flaky.

panels.title: Command failures
panels.description: main→Pi commands that timed out or found no Pi (printer roster, diagnostics, geo). Steady failures: the duplex channel is degraded — see Duplex RPC (debug).

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(rpc_timeouts_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(rpc_offline_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Print failures
panels.description: Print attempts where some ticket printed nowhere. Above 0: a printer is down or out of paper — see Pi & printers.

panels.title: Orders through each hop
panels.description: Orders per interval at each hop: received online → saved by main → pushed over SSE → acked by the Pi → accepted on the floor. Lines should overlap; a gap opening between two lines is where orders get stuck.

panels.title: Drops over time
panels.description: Every failure counter per interval. Any bar is a lost or delayed order at that hop — hover to see which, then open the logs.

panels.title: Orders saved per store
panels.description: Orders main saved, per store. A store going flat during its open hours while others keep flowing points at that store's vendor mapping (store_id).

panels.title: Time to accept (rolling 30 min)
panels.description: Arrival → accept on the tablet, p50/p90 per store (online + POS). p90 over 2 min (red line) means orders ring unattended at that store.

panels.title: Hop latency p95
panels.description: p95 time spent in each hop: online relay (POST → SQS ack), main sqs.process (consume → save → outbox), Pi order arrival handling and printing. A hop that jumps is the slow one; click a point's exemplar or use the trace link. Span metrics carry no store label.

panels.title: Outbox pending
panels.description: Rows waiting in main's outbox per handler. Should drain to 0 within seconds; flat above 0 for 15 min fires an alert — dispatch is stuck or no Pi is consuming.

panels.title: Unacked, re-sent and not synced
panels.description: Orders waiting for a Pi ack, re-sends per interval, and the Pis' floor-sync backlog. All three should hug zero.

panels.title: Floor events applied by main
panels.description: Floor events from the Pis by outcome. 'applied' is healthy; 'stale', 'invalid' or 'not_found' mean main and the Pi disagree about an order — check main's logs for that order.

panels.title: Command channel failures
panels.description: main→Pi commands that timed out or found no Pi connected, by command type. Occasional blips during a Pi restart are fine; a steady rate is a degraded link.

panels.title: Recent order traces
panels.description: The latest order-processing traces in main (sqs.process, with the Pi's spans chained underneath). Click a trace id to see exactly which hop was slow or failed. Not filtered by store.

panels.title: Pipeline errors
panels.description: Error lines from online, main and the Pis for this env (Pi lines filtered to the selected stores). Click a line's TraceID to jump to the trace. Repeated errors here explain the red Drops above.
